categories.main_business_segments: Jiaxing ZMAX Optech Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of precision optical lenses. Its product portfolio includes lenses for smart surveillance and sensing, intelligent detection and recognition, video communication and interaction, and high-definition shooting and display. The company also provides related technical development services and has subsidiaries focusing on optical design and manufacturing in China, Taiwan, and Japan.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced optical design integrating optics, mechanics, electronics, and precision manufacturing technologies. Key technologies include multi-element linkage zoom optical system design, wide-spectrum achromatic imaging, glass-plastic hybrid optical systems, high-precision optical component assembly and testing, plastic aspheric lens injection molding and coating, multi-element composite anti-shake design, and infrared optical lens design. Production mainly involves in-house lens assembly and testing, with some outsourced raw material processing and OEM procurement, supported by flexible production planning and partial self-manufacturing of core optical components.
categories.primary_customers_markets: ZMAX serves leading customers in digital security, intelligent manufacturing, automotive, consumer electronics, medical detection, and video communication sectors. Notable clients include Dahua, Hikvision, DJI, Huawei, Motorola, Amazon, Bosch, Panasonic, and others. The company’s products are applied in smart surveillance, industrial machine vision, intelligent driving, drones, AR/VR devices, and high-end video shooting and display equipment.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant domestic sales, complemented by overseas operations through subsidiaries in Taiwan and Japan. Overseas sales accounted for approximately 14% of revenue in 2023. The company’s R&D and production facilities are located in Zhejiang Province, China, with additional R&D centers in Taiwan and Japan.
categories.supply_chain_position: ZMAX operates mainly in the midstream segment of the optical lens supply chain, focusing on design, manufacturing, assembly, and testing of precision optical lenses. It sources customized raw materials and optical glass from upstream suppliers and delivers finished lens products and technical services downstream to device manufacturers and system integrators.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous innovation in high-performance optical lens technologies, expanding product lines in ultra-high-definition, ultra-long focal length, large zoom ratio, and glass-plastic hybrid lenses. R&D efforts focus on automotive camera lenses for autonomous driving, intelligent projection lenses, integrated zoom lenses with anti-shake, and 8K full-frame cinema lenses. It maintains a high R&D investment ratio (~10.7% of revenue) and actively pursues patent applications and standard-setting initiatives to sustain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: ZMAX generates revenue primarily through the direct sale of high-quality optical lens products and related technical development services. The company customizes products based on market and client requirements, with sales recognized upon delivery or client acceptance. Technical development income arises from delivering design specifications, validation reports, and prototype samples, sometimes leading to subsequent product sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in China’s precision optical lens industry, especially in high-difficulty segments such as ultra-large zoom lenses and ultra-long focal length lenses. It competes with established international players from Germany and Japan but leverages domestic innovation and localized production to capture growing market share. Its subsidiaries, including the experienced Kinoshita Optical in Japan, enhance its competitive edge in design and manufacturing.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, ZMAX reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 378.85 million, a 6.23% decrease year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 36.33 million, down 11.64%. Total assets grew 75.31% to RMB 1.02 billion, and shareholders’ equity increased 128.20% to RMB 838.30 million, mainly due to proceeds from its 2023 IPO. The company maintains healthy cash flow and continues investing heavily in R&D and capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: ZMAX emphasizes delivering high-quality, precision optical lenses with advanced imaging performance, including ultra-high definition, fast and accurate zoom, low distortion, and robust environmental adaptability. Its integration of optical, mechanical, electronic, and computational design enables customized solutions for diverse applications. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, patent portfolio, and internationalized development team differentiate it by offering innovative, reliable, and scalable optical products tailored to emerging markets such as AI-driven surveillance, intelligent driving, and high-end video communication.
